records.source: It's a pleasure to meet you. I'm Harvey, the local doctor.#$e#I perform regular check-ups and medical procedures for all the residents of Pelican Town. It's rewarding work.#$e#I hope you'll find your own work equally rewarding, in time.$h
records.translation: 很高興認識你。我是哈維，本地的醫生。#$e#我替鵜鶘鎮所有居民進行定期檢查與醫療處置。這份工作很有成就感。#$e#希望假以時日，你也會從自己的工作中獲得同樣的成就感。$h

records.source: Oh! Thank you very much! I didn't expect anyone to know it was my birthday today.$h
records.translation: 喔！非常謝謝你！沒想到會有人知道今天是我的生日。$h

records.source: Oh! It's a... well, it's something. I didn't expect anyone to know it was my birthday today.
records.translation: 喔！這是……嗯，確實是件東西。沒想到會有人知道今天是我的生日。

records.source: You're giving me this? I'm honored. Thank you!
records.translation: 你要把這個送給我？我深感榮幸。謝謝！

records.source: Oh! You... want to dance with me?$4#$b#...Yes. I'd love to!$h
records.translation: 喔！你……想和我跳舞？$4#$b#……好。我非常樂意！$h

records.source: I brought some medical supplies, just in case. Be careful out there!
records.translation: 我帶了一些醫療用品，以防萬一。在外面要小心！

records.source: The first time this happened, we were all worried that the rain might be dangerous.#$b#But what if it's actually healthy for the body? Who knows... The plants seem to respond well to it, at least.
records.translation: 這種情況第一次發生時，大家都擔心雨水可能很危險。#$b#但萬一它其實對身體有益呢？誰知道……至少植物似乎很適應。

records.source: It's for me? Thank you! This will be fantastic drizzled on some pasta.$h
records.translation: 這是給我的？謝謝！淋在義大利麵上一定非常美味。$h

records.source: For me? What a gift! This looks fantastic!$h#$b#You know, on a physiological level, I wouldn't advise the consumption of alcohol...#$b#But there's no denying the benefit of kicking back and enjoying a glass of fine Stardew Valley wine!$h
records.translation: 給我的？真是份好禮！看起來太棒了！$h#$b#你知道，從生理層面來說，我不建議飲用酒精……#$b#但悠閒地享用一杯星露谷佳釀，帶來的好處也不可否認！$h

records.source: I've been working on an 'animal checklist' for a few years now. I want to observe every species living in the valley!
records.translation: 我花了好幾年整理一份「動物清單」。我想觀察山谷裡生活的每一個物種！

records.source: I tried making my own pickles one time...$s#$e#Um, let me put it this way... The frogs we dissected in high school smelled like roses in comparison...
records.translation: 我曾經試著自己醃製泡菜……$s#$e#呃，這麼說吧……相比之下，我們高中解剖的青蛙聞起來簡直像玫瑰……

records.source: As a small town doctor, you can't help but form a personal connection with your patients. That can be both good and bad...
records.translation: 身為小鎮醫生，難免會和病患建立私人情感。這既可能是好事，也可能是壞事……

records.source: Well now that you know my secret, I might as well give you an update... I was significantly less winded after aerobics class this week!
records.translation: 既然你知道了我的祕密，不妨跟你說說近況……這星期上完有氧舞蹈課後，我喘得明顯沒那麼厲害了！

records.source: I got such a good workout during aerobics class, I think I can treat myself to some pasta primavera tonight...$h
records.translation: 有氧舞蹈課讓我充分運動了一番，今晚應該可以犒賞自己一盤春蔬義大利麵……$h

records.source: I don't know why I was ashamed about being in dance aerobics class. My legs have become so strong, I should feel as bold as a lion!
records.translation: 不知道我為什麼曾因參加有氧舞蹈課而難為情。我的雙腿變得這麼強壯，應該像獅子一樣自信才對！

records.source: I've never told anyone about my airplane hobby before... I guess I just feel comfortable talking to you.
records.translation: 我以前從未告訴任何人自己對飛機的愛好……大概是因為和你交談讓我覺得很自在。

records.source: As a doctor, you can only do so much to help your patients...#$e#I've made the mistake of getting too emotionally involved in the past... I won't let that happen again...$s
records.translation: 身為醫生，能為病患做的終究有限……#$e#我過去犯過投入太多情感的錯誤……不會再讓那種事發生了……$s

records.source: I've never felt like this before...$l
records.translation: 我從未有過這種感覺……$l

records.source: I've been thinking about you so much, I can hardly do my work.$l
records.translation: 我一直在想你，幾乎無法工作。$l

records.source: Maru's been unusually cheerful lately... I hear you may have something to do with that.
records.translation: 瑪魯最近異常開朗……聽說這可能和你有關。

records.source: Congratulations on your marriage, @. Maru's already informed me that she'll continue to work at the clinic, which is a relief!
records.translation: 恭喜你結婚，@。瑪魯已經告訴我，她會繼續在診所工作，這讓我鬆了口氣！

records.source: This is the happiest moment of my life...$l
records.translation: 這是我一生中最幸福的時刻……$l

records.source: Sunscreen? Check...#$b#Sun hat? Check...
records.translation: 防曬乳？帶了……#$b#遮陽帽？帶了……

records.source: If you get burnt, a little aloe vera cream might help soothe the skin.
records.translation: 如果曬傷了，塗點蘆薈乳霜也許能舒緩肌膚。

records.source: I combed the whole beach for glass. We wouldn't want anyone to get a cut on their foot!
records.translation: 我把整片沙灘都仔細搜尋了一遍，看看有沒有玻璃。我們可不希望有人割傷腳！

records.source: It's nice to have an opportunity to relax now and then.#$b#The trouble is actually letting go of your worries...$s
records.translation: 偶爾有機會放鬆一下真不錯。#$b#困難的是實際放下心中的憂慮……$s

records.source: It's important to stay hydrated in this heat. I'm going to ask Gus if he has any coconut water!$h
records.translation: 在這種炎熱天氣裡，補充水分很重要。我要問問格斯有沒有椰子水！$h

records.source: I'll let you in on a little secret... I can only swim with floaties.$s
records.translation: 告訴你一個小祕密……我戴著浮臂圈才會游泳。$s

records.source: I've been looking forward to it all afternoon! You look radiant in the fresh spring air, my love.$l
records.translation: 我整個下午都在期待！親愛的，你在清新的春日空氣中顯得容光煥發。$l

records.source: Oh! I'm sorry... I, er... have plans to ask someone else.$s
records.translation: 喔！對不起……我，呃……打算邀請別人。$s

records.source: I... I can't look at you. Please spare me any more pain.$s
records.translation: 我……我無法看著你。請別再讓我承受更多痛苦。$s

records.source: ...Y...You...?$s#$b#*gulp*... I... I think I'm going to be sick...$s
records.translation: ……你……你……？$s#$b#*吞嚥*……我……我覺得自己要吐了……$s

records.source: I'm busy with my work. I can't speak to you.$s
records.translation: 我正忙著工作，不能和你說話。$s

records.source: I want you back in my life, @. I'm willing to forget what happened.$s
records.translation: 我希望你回到我的生命中，@。我願意忘記發生過的事。$s

records.source: We sell a few over-the-counter medicines at the clinic... feel free to stop by if you're feeling exhausted.#$b#I know that being a farmer is pretty tiring work... don't overdo it!
records.translation: 診所有販售幾種非處方藥……如果覺得筋疲力盡，隨時可以過來。#$b#我知道務農相當辛苦……別累壞自己！

records.source: I feel responsible for the health of this whole community... it's kind of stressful.#$e#It's a pretty small community, and I'm fortunate to be able to build a good relationship with my patients.
records.translation: 我覺得自己對整個社區的健康負有責任……壓力有點大。#$e#這個社區很小，我很幸運能和病患建立良好的關係。

records.source: I'd like to stay in Stardew Valley for a while. I'm finally starting to feel involved in the community.#$e#It feels good to know that you're useful.
records.translation: 我想在星露谷多待一陣子。終於開始覺得自己融入這個社區了。#$e#知道自己能派上用場，感覺很好。

records.source: Oh! Hi, @.$l#$e#Do you... have any medical questions?$l
records.translation: 喔！嗨，@。$l#$e#你……有任何醫療方面的問題嗎？$l

records.source: Feel free to stop by my office if you're ever feeling ill.#$e#You're young, though. You'll probably stay healthy without trying.$h
records.translation: 如果身體不舒服，隨時可以來我的診間。#$e#不過你還年輕。大概不必特別努力就能保持健康。$h

records.source: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#Don't overwork yourself, @. Doctor's orders!#$e#If our farmers get sick, where will we get our food? We need you!$h|Don't overwork yourself, @. Doctor's orders!#$e#Your health is important to me.$l
records.translation: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#別讓自己工作過度，@。這是醫囑！#$e#要是我們的農夫病倒了，大家要去哪裡找食物？我們需要你！$h|別讓自己工作過度，@。這是醫囑！#$e#你的健康對我很重要。$l

records.source: I'd like to get to know you better, @. Let's put aside our doctor-patient relationship.
records.translation: 我想更深入地瞭解你，@。暫且拋開我們的醫病關係吧。

records.source: It's nice to have a friend in town.$h
records.translation: 鎮上有個朋友真好。$h

records.source: You have a really healthy glow. That's good.$h
records.translation: 你的氣色非常健康。這是好事。$h

records.source: Remember to cover your mouth when you sneeze.#$e#Then make sure to wash your hands.
records.translation: 打噴嚏時記得遮住嘴巴。#$e#之後一定要洗手。

records.source: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#As a doctor, I'm well aware of the benefits of home-cooked food. But I'm so busy, I have a hard time bringing myself to cook.$s|It's a lot of work, being a doctor. I don't eat as well as I should.$s#$e#If I didn't live alone I think it would be easier.$l
records.translation: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#身為醫生，我很清楚家常菜的好處。但工作實在太忙，我很難讓自己動手下廚。$s|當醫生工作繁重。我的飲食品質不如應有的水準。$s#$e#如果不是獨居，我想會輕鬆一些。$l

records.source: Nutrition is important, so make sure and eat well. Try to increase your vegetable intake!#$e#Home-cooked meals are best. Do you cook?
records.translation: 營養很重要，所以一定要好好吃飯。試著增加蔬菜攝取量！#$e#家常菜最健康。你會下廚嗎？

records.source: It's a beautiful day, isn't it?#$e#I wish I had less work to do.$s
records.translation: 今天很美好，對吧？#$e#真希望工作能少一點。$s

records.source: If you want to hang out in my apartment, that's okay with me. I live above the clinic.
records.translation: 如果想來我的公寓坐坐，我不介意。我住在診所樓上。

records.source: Stop by my place if you ever need a confidential check-up.$l
records.translation: 如果需要私下檢查，隨時可以到我家來。$l

records.source: Can I do anything for you?#$e#Take care.
records.translation: 有什麼是我能替你做的嗎？#$e#保重。

records.source: I came here because I liked the small-town atmosphere, and the potential for a holistic approach to patient care.#$e#I've grown to really love it.$h
records.translation: 我喜歡小鎮的氛圍，也看中這裡以全人觀點照護病患的潛力，所以才來到這裡。#$e#現在我真的愛上這裡了。$h

records.source: *Sigh*... I'm starting to feel kind of old...#$e#The older you get the more memories you're burdened with. It can be overwhelming.$s#$e#I think I'll stay younger with you around.$l
records.translation: *嘆氣*……我開始覺得自己有點老了……#$e#年紀越大，背負的回憶就越多。有時會讓人不堪重負。$s#$e#我想有你在身邊，我會保持年輕。$l

records.source: Hmm... I'm struggling to make ends meet. I don't have enough patients.#$e#I guess I should try to get patients from the neighboring towns...
records.translation: 嗯……我的收入很難維持生計。病患人數不夠。#$e#看來我應該試著吸引鄰近城鎮的病患……

records.source: Imagine having a patient's life completely in your hands, and failing to keep them alive... that's something that will haunt you forever.$s
records.translation: 想像一位病患的性命完全掌握在你手中，你卻沒能讓他活下來……那會成為糾纏你一生的陰影。$s

records.source: Thanks, @.$h#$b#You see, George, I'm just trying to help you.
records.translation: 謝謝，@。$h#$b#你看，喬治，我只是想幫你。

records.source: *Sigh*$s#$b#Look, George. If you want to behave like this I'm going to have to tell your wife. I don't think she'll be happy.
records.translation: *嘆氣*$s#$b#聽著，喬治。你要是繼續這樣，我就不得不告訴你太太。我想她不會高興。

records.source: Thanks, @. I appreciate that.$h
records.translation: 謝謝，@。我很感激。$h

records.source: *Sigh*... rude.$s
records.translation: *嘆氣*……真沒禮貌。$s

records.source: Oh! Hospitals make you nervous, huh?#$b#Just try and relax. I'm here to help.$h
records.translation: 喔！醫院讓你緊張，對吧？#$b#試著放鬆。我是來幫你的。$h

records.source: Okay. That makes sense.
records.translation: 好。這很合理。

records.source: Um. Okay... If you say so.$s
records.translation: 呃，好吧……既然你這麼說。$s

records.source: ...You're right.#$b#...Thanks.
records.translation: ……你說得對。#$b#……謝謝。

records.source: *sigh*$s
records.translation: *嘆氣*$s

records.source: It's okay to get a moderate amount of sunlight. Just don't get burnt.#$e#Okay. Take care! Stay healthy.
records.translation: 適度曬太陽沒有問題，只要別曬傷。#$e#好了。保重！保持健康。

records.source: Exercise is important, but don't get too exhausted, or you might end up at my clinic!#$e#Make sure and listen to your body.
records.translation: 運動很重要，但別累過頭，否則最後可能會進我的診所！#$e#一定要傾聽身體的聲音。

records.source: People don't get sick much during the summer. That's nice, but it also means less business for me.
records.translation: 人們在夏天不太容易生病。這很好，但也表示我的生意變少了。

records.source: Have you been going into the mines, @?#$e#It's a dangerous place. I recommend against it.
records.translation: 你最近常去礦井嗎，@？#$e#那裡很危險。我不建議你去。

records.source: When you eat certain foods you'll perform better.#$e#Eating a 'Farmer's Lunch' will give you the nutrition you need to water and harvest crops better!
records.translation: 吃下特定食物後，你會有更好的表現。#$e#享用一份「農夫午餐」，就能獲得更有效率地澆水與收穫作物所需的營養！

records.source: It's flu season, so you'd better be extra careful.#$e#Make sure to wash your hands often.
records.translation: 現在是流感季節，你最好格外小心。#$e#一定要勤洗手。

records.source: I hate to say this, but I do make a lot more money during flu season.#$e#I guess if people stopped getting sick, I'd be out of business.#$e#Don't get the wrong idea! I want people to be healthy... really!
records.translation: 雖然不願承認，但我在流感季節確實賺得多很多。#$e#我想，要是大家不再生病，我就會失業。#$e#別誤會！我希望大家都保持健康……真的！
